title: Grateful Dead Live at Delta Center on 1995-02-21
lineage: Fostex D5 DAT (playback of DAT Master record) @ 16-bits, 48 kHz (S/PDIF optical out) > M-Audio Firewire Audiophile external soundcard > Magix Sound Forge Pro Suite 12.1 build 170 x64  Audacity used for tracking, tagging, flac8 conversion
source: AKGC60B+CK8x shotgun in OTS, ~34’ to St.L of C (inline w/hanging PA; aimed at the PA) > Panasonic SV-255 (Paul Tumolo’s rig) Analog or Digi out, possibly via custom patchbay built by Neil Sturtevant (detail not noted) > Sony TCD-D3 DAT @ 48 kHz

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard captures a favorite show featuring stellar Friend of the Devil, Foolish and Truckin' performances
ai_review.review: The recording is a clean, crisp sound‑board source that lets listeners hear every nuance, while the performance shines with standout versions of Friend of the Devil, Foolish and an incendiary Truckin'. Reviewers rave about the solos from Jerry Garcia and Vince Welnick, calling this one of the best shows they own.

ai_rating.rationale: A single five‑star review praises both the musical performance and the recording quality; with limited data the rating is high but confidence remains low.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear soundboard mix; reviewer notes it sounds great and even tried to find an audience source for comparison.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Set 2 highlighted as a high point with strong solos and an “average” space segment; overall flow praised as one of the reviewer’s favorites.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Excellent solo noted by the reviewer.
band_member_comments.Keys: Vince (keys) receives praise for his solos.
